title: Llama dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- back legs dancing -->
  <rect x='48' y='62' width='10' height='22' rx='4' fill='#e8cfa0'/>
  <rect x='44' y='80' width='12' height='6' rx='3' fill='#c9a36a'/>
  <!-- front legs dancing up -->
  <rect x='28' y='58' width='9' height='24' rx='4' fill='#f0d9ae'/>
  <rect x='36' y='54' width='9' height='22' rx='4' fill='#e8cfa0' transform='rotate(-25 40 65)'/>
  <!-- hoof -->
  <rect x='22' y='78' width='12' height='6' rx='3' fill='#c9a36a'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='58' rx='18' ry='14' fill='#f5e3ba'/>
  <!-- fluffy chest -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='52' r='7' fill='#fff3d6'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='48' r='6' fill='#fff3d6'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='24' y='30' width='11' height='24' rx='5' fill='#f0d9ae'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='28' rx='11' ry='10' fill='#f5e3ba'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='19' rx='3' ry='6' fill='#e8cfa0' transform='rotate(-20 20 19)'/>
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='18' rx='3' ry='6' fill='#e8cfa0' transform='rotate(20 35 18)'/>
  <!-- inner ear -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='19' rx='1.5' ry='3.5' fill='#f2a0b0' transform='rotate(-20 20 19)'/>
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='18' rx='1.5' ry='3.5' fill='#f2a0b0' transform='rotate(20 35 18)'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='31' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#ffe9c4'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='29' cy='25' r='2' fill='#5a3e6b'/>
  <circle cx='29.8' cy='24.2' r='0.7' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M18 33 Q22 36 26 33' stroke='#c97a8a' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail fluff -->
  <circle cx='60' cy='52' r='5' fill='#fff3d6'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='56' r='4' fill='#fff3d6'/>
  <!-- dance motion sparkles -->
  <path d='M70 30 l2 5 l5 2 l-5 2 l-2 5 l-2 -5 l-5 -2 l5 -2 z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <path d='M12 50 l1.5 3.5 l3.5 1.5 l-3.5 1.5 l-1.5 3.5 l-1.5 -3.5 l-3.5 -1.5 l3.5 -1.5 z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <path d='M72 68 l1.5 3 l3 1.5 l-3 1.5 l-1.5 3 l-1.5 -3 l-3 -1.5 l3 -1.5 z' fill='#ff9ec7'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='45' r='3' fill='#7ce0d3'/>
  <rect x='79.5' y='33' width='2' height='12' fill='#7ce0d3'/>
  <path d='M79.5 33 Q86 34 85 39' stroke='#7ce0d3' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='22' r='2' fill='#ff9ec7'/>
  <rect x='67' y='13' width='1.5' height='9' fill='#ff9ec7'/>
</svg>
